status: declared before any score (#475, a track of #374); a scratch measurement, nothing published moves
form: logistic regression of the pressure day on the logits of the five tier-1 passers' probabilities and the as-of regime, refitted at each refit block
members_note: the five candidates that pass tier 1 (onset warning) under both false-alarm rules at the weighted-miss run (docs/pivot/weighted-miss-result.md, Table 1); the other tier-1 passers of that run (rare_gbm_focal+recalibrated, two_part_logistic) pass under the weighted rule only and are not members
regime_note: the as-of regime of metadata/evaluation_splits.json, a function of the day's calendar date; one indicator per label, so a regime with no day in the training window keeps the coefficient 0
design: for each threshold and horizon: log-odds of P(spread > tau) = intercept + sum_m w_m * logit(clip(p_m)) + sum_r c_r * [regime = r]

fit.method: Newton's method on the penalised log loss; the intercept is not penalised
fit.penalty: (ridge / 2) * (sum_m (w_m - 1/M)^2 + sum_r c_r^2): the member weights are pulled towards the equal-weight logit pool, the regime coefficients towards 0

refit.blocks: the judge's blocks: scored days 0..20, 21..41, ... of the shared fold grid
refit.training_window: the scored days of earlier blocks whose outcome was public at the block's first decision instant, as pressure_judge.choose_cutoffs reads it: up to the business day h + 1 business days before the block's first scored day
refit.members_read: each member's own walk-forward probabilities, made before the refit, out of sample when made

isotonic.fit: probability_calibration's CORP isotonic fit of the outcome on the stack's probability
isotonic.training_pairs: the stack's walk-forward probabilities (each made by an earlier refit, before the day's outcome) and the outcomes of the same training window; never the stack's in-sample fit

fallback.rule: the equal-weight logit pool (intercept 0, every member weight 1/M, regime coefficients 0) and, for the isotonic candidate, no recalibration
fallback.when: the training window has fewer than 126 scored days, or fewer than 5 pressure days at the threshold, or fewer than 5 days without

scoring: pressure_judge.py judge under the weighted miss rule (adopted on #464; run with --rule weighted, and beside it unweighted), the declaration of metadata/pressure_judge.json, scored days 2018-06-29 to 2025-12-31 only; each stack is a candidate there, each member alone is a row beside it
